narr: An upper low-pressure system tracked north of the region while the associated cold front moved through the Mid-South during the evening hours of April 7th. Clusters of storms formed into a poorly organized line that pushed east across the Mid-South. There were a few reports of damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: Highway 51 in Coldwater was flooded with over 6 inches of water covering all four lanes.
lsr: HIGHWAY 51 IN COLDWATER FLOODED OVER ALL 4 LANES 6 TO 8 INCHES DEEP.
